# Laravel Plugin Discovery

Curated by Skill Harbor: a package-discovery workflow that turns "what package should I use for auth?" into an evidence-based answer. The skill drives the LaraPlugins.io MCP server, which is free for the Laravel community with no API key required. Two tools do the work: SearchPluginTool finds packages by keyword with filters for health band (Healthy, Medium, Unhealthy, Unrated), Laravel version (5 through 13), PHP version (7.4 through 8.5), and vendor (spatie, laravel, and the rest); GetPluginDetailsTool pulls health score, last activity, the Laravel and PHP version support matrix, vendor reputation and risk score, and version history for any full Composer package name. The filtering guidance is opinionated: always filter by health for production, always match the target project's Laravel version, prefer known vendors, and review details before recommending. Worked examples cover finding authentication packages, Laravel 12-compatible admin panels, and vendor-wide searches. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: health scores are indicators, not guarantees; a Healthy band today does not promise maintenance tomorrow, so read the actual readme and recent commits before committing a dependency. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
